host.description: Host name for the application, like 'bbb.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

public_address.title: Public IP address
public_address.description: The address WebRTC clients use to reach this node. It is announced by mediasoup, not bound locally, so a NAT address is correct here. Detected at install time; override when a port-forward uses a different address.

private_address.title: LAN IP address
private_address.description: Optional. When set, mediasoup also advertises this address so clients on the local network connect directly instead of relying on NAT reflection.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: Optional, like 'stun:stun.example.org:3478'. Empty by default: this module ships no coturn, and a public STUN server would receive every participant's IP address.

turn_ext_server.title: External TURN server
turn_ext_server.description: Optional, like 'turns:turn.example.org:443?transport=tcp'. Without it, clients behind UDP-blocking firewalls cannot join.

enable_recording.title: Enable recording
enable_recording.description: Record meetings. Recordings capture everything that happens in the conference: obtain participants' consent.

disable_sound_alone.title: Disable alone announcement
disable_sound_alone.description: Suppress the "You are the only person in this conference" announcement

welcome_message.title: Welcome message
welcome_message.description: Replaces the default welcome message shown in the chat

welcome_footer.title: Welcome footer
welcome_footer.description: Replaces the default welcome footer shown in the chat

remove_old_recording.title: Delete old recordings
remove_old_recording.description: Let the periodic maintenance job delete recordings past their retention. Requires recording to be enabled.

recording_max_age_days.title: Recording retention (days)
recording_max_age_days.description: Recordings older than this are deleted, provided deletion is enabled.
